review_question: Does the draft guide design cover its states, tokens and accessibility basics well enough to put in front of trial users?

findings.title: 'Skip the guide' does not say the guide can come back
findings.notice: The secondary action reads 'Skip the guide' while the help screen offers to reopen it at the same step.
findings.because: Someone who skips may think the guide is gone for good, which works against the promise of three steps.
findings.recommendation: Label it 'Skip for now' and add a one-line hint that Help reopens the guide at this step.

findings.title: Display and body share one family, so hierarchy rests on size and weight
findings.notice: Display and body both use Source Sans 3.
findings.because: That fits a quiet operate surface, but headings depend on the 1.25 scale and weight alone.
findings.recommendation: Keep it, and check in a rendered screenshot that the step heading still leads at phone width.

handoff.notes: Copy and design changes go back to the design consultation; nothing is built from this draft yet.
